title: commit-msg refuses files inside another agent's live claim
goal: A task recorded in the checkout but not claimed (tasks start's claim refused for an overlap) let its commit through with no scope check, so cloud-claude's 186ccc85 edited docs/console.md inside cloud-antigravity's live claim. The commit-msg hook now refuses a staged file that lies inside a live claim another agent holds on another task, naming the file, the claim and its agent.
